UNIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978
Order under Section 25A

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 25 A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, I, A. Ibathul Rauff Hakeem,the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, having obtained a report under section 70C of theaforesaid Act, in respect of the Esoft Metro Campus (Private) Limited, a Company incorporated in Sri Lanka under theCompanies Act, No. 7 of 2007 and bearing Registration Number PV 94112 and first registered on 23.08.2013 andamalgamated on 02.02.2018, located at No. 03, De Fonseka Place, Colombo 04, do by this Order and subject to theconditions specified in Schedule I hereto, recognize the Esoft Metro Campus (Pvt) Limited as a Degree Awarding Institutefor the purpose of developing Higher Education therein, leading to the award of the Degree specified in Column I of theSchedule II hereto, of which the abbreviation is set out in the corresponding entry in Column II of the Schedule II hereto:-
SCHEDULE I
CONDITIONS
1.Esoft Metro Campus (Private) Limited shall conduct the degree programme relevant to the Degreespecified in Schedule II hereto, only at No. 03, De Fonseka Place, Colombo 04.

2. Esoft Metro Campus (Private) Limited shall, within five (5) years from the date of publication of this Order,submit the evidence of the establishment of the institute sought to be established under this Order, in alocation registered under the name of the institute to the specified Authority.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A - PG 4638 — 517 (09/2019)

3. Esoft Metro Campus (Private) Limited is allowed to offer the Degree specified in Schedule II hereto,only for a period of five (5) years from the date of publication of this Order, subject to the enrollment ofstudents, enabling them to complete said degree within the prescribed five (5) years.

4.Esoft Metro Campus (Private) Limited shall ensure that the students who enroll within the aforesaidperiod of five years (5) shall complete the Degree programme relevant to the Degree specified in ScheduleII hereto, within the said period of five (5) years.
5. Esoft Metro Campus (Private) Limited is allowed to offer the Degree specified in Schedule II hereto, subjectto the programme re-review to be conducted by the specified Authority.

6. Esoft Metro Campus (Private) Limited shall, when admitting students for the degree programme relavantto the Degree specified in Schedule II hereto, in respect of the Bachelor of Information TechnologyHonours, adhere to the minimum entry qualifications of three (3) simple passes (‘S’) passes in any subjectstream in one and the same sitting at the GCE (Advanced Level) Examination or equivalent.
